about_the_game:
The Last Case of John Morley Demo

Step into the shoes of detective John Morley in this captivating demo set in the gritty noir atmosphere of the 1940s. After recovering from injuries sustained in his last case, Morley returns to his office where he receives a visit from the enigmatic Lady Margarette Fordside, an English countess haunted by a tragic past.

In this demo, you'll experience the beginning of the investigation as Lady Fordside engages Morley to investigate the unsolved murder of her daughter, which occurred on a fateful night 20 years ago. The police had closed the case by arresting scapegoats, but the countess is convinced that the real killer remains at large.

What the demo includes:

  • First-person investigation in detailed and atmospheric environments

  • Puzzle-solving system and evidence analysis

  • Immersive 1940s atmosphere with evocative soundtrack

  • A taste of the suspenseful narrative that will leave you wanting more

Experience the beginning of this 3-hour mystery and discover if you have what it takes to unravel secrets that have remained hidden for decades.

The demo provides a complete introduction to the game mechanics and the opening chapters of this gripping detective story.
